name: build-make
description: A C program that does not compile: main.c calls clamp() with two arguments where the header declares three. Build, read the compiler error, fix the source, rebuild.
proves: the shell tool round trip — run a build, parse a real compiler diagnostic, edit the right file, verify by rebuilding and running the binary
prompt:
This C project does not build. Run `make`, read the compiler error, and fix the source so the build succeeds. Then run `make run` and check the output.

`build/app` must print exactly `clamped=7`. Do not edit the Makefile and do not change `src/util.c` or `src/util.h` — the bug is on the calling side.

pre_checks.label: the build fails before the agent runs
the seeded call site is present

checks.label: the build was actually run by the agent, not guessed
nothing outside the project was touched
